observations.body: The warning about practices that do not inherit God’s Kingdom stands between the works of the flesh and the fruit of the Spirit.
observations.label: Works, fruit, and Kingdom inheritance

observations.body: The passage places Entry and inheritance beside works, fruit, and kingdom inheritance.
observations.label: Entry and inheritance

payload.posture: Read Galatians 5:16–26 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the warning about practices that do not inherit God’s Kingdom stands between the works of the flesh and the fruit of the Spirit. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
payload.title: Works, fruit, and Kingdom inheritance
